label: Actual grounding well-foundedness gives selected-world acyclicity (inference)
rule: Specialize the regress schema's constructive cycle exclusion
meaning: Use the actual-concrete grounding graph with nodes restricted to candidates concrete and existing at the supplied world and with the same Profile.grounds edges there. Well-foundedness of those edges excludes every nonempty finite return path by the graph law. This introduces no actual inhabitant and requires no excluded-middle premise.
